privacy_and_account_risk_observation.official_page_status: The Meridial contractor privacy policy is the more specific and newer public source and displays Effective Date March 2nd 2026. The older Invisible marketplace policy displays Effective Date July 13th 2021 and Last updated 10/4/2021 and is retained only as historical context.
observed_categories: The current policy describes collection of account, residence, education, employment, reference, CV, taxpayer, government-ID, payment, communication, project, and task information.
Identity verification may include selfies, government-ID images, video or audio, and facial measurements that may be biometric or sensitive data.
Upon notice, task monitoring may include screen recording, webcam presence verification, and eye-tracking analysis; monitoring is described as a condition of platform access.
Information shared with clients can include contact details, qualifications, work product, screen recordings, and biometric monitoring data where required by a client agreement.
Integrity and identity-verification records may be retained for up to three years following the last interaction, or as needed for legal obligations.
Client-specific tools and privacy practices may be controlled separately by the client.
privacy_and_account_risk_observation.decision_effect: Before any application, identity verification, assessment, account creation, or contractor acceptance, the exact current privacy policy, terms, requested personal-data fields, monitoring scope, client identity, work authorization, tax, payment, retention, and deletion consequences require user review and exact authorization.

observed_mix: Some self-reported applicants describe spending multiple hours on assessments, unclear scoring, stalled verification, weak support, or no project assignment.
Some self-reported contractors describe paid training time, successful payment, and useful projects, while other comments describe patchy project availability or rates below alternatives.

A BBB complaint describes a fraudulent-check and equipment-purchase recruitment scam using the company name; that report does not prove the official Greenhouse or Meridial process caused it and may reflect impersonation.
non_authoritative_experience_counterevid.evidence_limit: These reports are anecdotal, self-selected, and not independently verified. They establish plausible failure modes, not their frequency and not a verdict that the official opportunity is legitimate or illegitimate.
non_authoritative_experience_counterevid.decision_effect: Any future packet must use only official domains, prohibit checks, equipment purchases, deposits, fees, or off-platform payment, predefine an unpaid-assessment time cap, and require exact contract and payment terms before work begins.

cross_lead_inference.claim: Public pages provide direct evidence that organizations request evaluation, QA, adversarial testing, failure taxonomies, reproducible traces, and structured feedback. They do not establish that this user will be selected, paid at any particular rate, assigned hours, or permitted to work under the relevant terms.
cross_lead_inference.portfolio_implication: A small content-addressed local evaluation artifact can be assessed as portfolio evidence against explicit job requirements, but passing it is neither demand validation nor application authorization.

current_decision.next_local_only_action: Preserve exact public source bytes or full screenshots for one selected lead, independently recheck freshness, perform fit and privacy gap analysis, and prepare an exact application-risk packet without entering a form or contacting anyone.

claim_boundary: This locator record shows public demand signals and risks only. It is not a raw capture, current application Gate receipt, fit proof, work-authorization determination, offer, contract, payment proof, demand validation for a new product, or authorization for any external action.
